label: Fallible correction
resolution: The new protocol is an executable online update with extensional mistake bounds. Actual correctness is evaluated against separately supplied truth, not coherence or agreement. A bounded corruption regime permits conditional error control without exact all-state classification. Neither actual reliability nor existence of the algorithm establishes accessible justification, evidence calibration or normative authority. Warranted correction remains the separate philosophical standard; no threshold is defined to be justification. Lucky correctness, misleading labels, reliable-but-unjustified and justified-but-fallible cases are distinguished in docs/notes/fallible-correction-931.md.
